## D10 — 1min + 单鱼抽样

### 常量
shared/constants.ts: FISH_BITE_CHECK_MS = 60_000
shared/fishing.ts:
  SPOT_FISH_PICK_BY_QUALITY = true
  SPOT_FISH_PICK_BY_BITE = false
  pickSpotFishCandidate(candidates: PondFishEntity[]): PondFishEntity

抽鱼权重 = FISH_QUALITIES[].weight（38/28/18/9/4/2/1）

### rollBiteHook 新流程
1. candidates = listPondFishAtSpot(pondId, spotId) \ locked
2. if empty → return null（触发空杆飘字，见 D12-4B）
3. target = pickSpotFishCandidate(candidates)
4. pBite = clamp01(spotMult × (calcQualitySizeBiteRate(target)×mult + baitBonus))
5. if random() >= pBite → return null（空杆）
6. hook target，走现有脱钩/收杆逻辑

删除：calcTickBiteProbability(Σ) 用于咬钩判定；咬钩后不再二次加权抽鱼。

### 迁移
game_config.FISH_BITE_CHECK_MS = 60000；getBiteCheckMs() 下限 60000
server/index.ts、bots.ts、fishingStateMachine 咬钩循环同步
